allChannels: All channels the bot is in
allGroups: All groups the bot is in
answersInHelp: Where it answers when mentioned. Private chats follow the switch above.
answersInHelpSlack: Where it answers when mentioned. Direct messages follow the switch above. Channels include group DMs.
canPostHelpChannel: Whether the agent may post to a channel other than the conversation it answers in. Its replies there are not affected.
canPostHelpGroup: Whether the agent may post to a group other than the conversation it answers in. Its replies there are not affected.
canSearchRead: Channels it can search and read
channelJoinsLater: A channel the bot joins later stays off until you check it.
channelsSwitchedOff: Channels are switched off above, so it answers in none.
groupJoinsLater: A group the bot joins later stays off until you check it.
groupsSwitchedOff: Group chats are switched off above, so it answers in none.
listChannelsFailed: Could not list the channels the bot is in.
noChannelCheckedAnswers: With no channel checked, the agent answers in no channel.
noChannelCheckedRead: With no channel checked, the agent cannot search or read any.
noChannelYet: The bot is in no channel yet.
noGroupCheckedAnswers: With no group checked, the agent answers in no group.
noGroupCheckedRead: With no group checked, the agent cannot search or read any.
noGroupYet: The bot is in no group yet.
telegramReadHelp: Telegram does not let bots read chat history, so the bot can read only messages it received.
